title: Elon Musk is steamrolling Wall Street to become a trillionaire
summary: Today on Decoder, I’m talking to Ryan Mac, a technology reporter at The New York Times and coauthor of the excellent book Character Limit: How Elon Musk Destroyed Twitter, which came out in 2024.
